patterns.note: The hero section features an asymmetrical layout with a dominant, oversized name centered, flanked by two distinct, full-bleed images that create visual tension and interest.
A dramatic contrast in typography is used, pairing an extremely large, elegant serif display font for the primary identity with a subtle, clean sans-serif for navigation and secondary information.
A highly restrained and sophisticated color palette is employed, primarily using a warm off-white background with stark black text, creating a high-contrast, minimalist aesthetic.
The main hero content, including the oversized name and images, scrolls naturally up the page, passing underneath a fixed, transparent navigation bar at the top.

The homepage is structured as a single, impactful hero section that serves as a strong personal brand statement, with further content implied by the navigation links rather than immediately visible sections.

technique_notes: The hero section is designed with a full-width container, featuring a centrally aligned, extremely large text element rendered in an elegant serif font. Below this, two images are placed side-by-side, each occupying half the width, with one image intentionally blurred or grainy to create a distinct visual texture.

A minimal navigation bar is positioned at the very top of the viewport and is set to remain fixed as the user scrolls. The main page content is layered beneath this sticky header, allowing elements like the large hero text to scroll up and disappear behind the navigation.

The scroll-triggered motion is limited to a sticky header. As the user scrolls down, the primary content simply moves upwards, with the large hero text passing underneath the fixed navigation bar, creating a simple layering effect without complex animations or parallax.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, elegant serif display font (~8-10x body text) dominates the hero, contrasted with small, understated sans-serif for navigation and secondary text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous whitespace around the main name and images, creating a sense of openness and luxury.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and confident use of an extremely oversized, elegant serif typeface as the primary visual anchor, combined with artistic, slightly unconventional imagery. This creates an immediate, strong personal brand statement that feels more like an editorial spread than a typical portfolio site.
